title: Sudoku puzzle with notes and checking
when: The user wants a playable sudoku with puzzles by difficulty, pencil notes, conflict highlighting and hints.
prompt:
Goal: A keyboard first 9x9 puzzle that flags conflicts, supports notes and always has a valid solution.
Steps:
1. Puzzles as 81 character strings (0 for empty) grouped easy, medium, hard; given cells locked.
2. logic.mjs: parse, peers(i) for row, column and box, conflicts(board), solve(board) by backtracking on the cell with fewest candidates, isComplete.
3. 81 cell buttons with roving tabindex: arrows move, 1 to 9 enter, Backspace clears, N toggles notes mode.
4. Notes show small candidates; placing a digit removes it from peer notes.
5. Highlight row, column, box and same digit; conflicts get color plus underline and "conflict" in the aria-label.
6. Hint fills one cell from solve; timer; progress in localStorage guarded; win in aria-live.
7. test.mjs: 20 peers, conflicts, solves a known puzzle, rejects an unsolvable one.
Quality bar:
- Box borders thicker than cell borders.
- Given digits styled apart from entries.
- On screen digit pad for phones.
Pitfalls:
- Solver too slow without the fewest candidates rule.
- Notes lost on reload.
- Locked cells editable by keyboard.
Verify:
- [ ] Solver tested.
- [ ] Cells labeled.
- [ ] Status live.
- [ ] node test.mjs passes.
Output: index.html, style.css, app.js, logic.mjs (rules and solver), puzzles.js, test.mjs.

examples.input: sudoku com niveis facil medio e dificil
examples.output: grid with notes mode, conflict marks, Hint, timer
